name: Belkahve Tunnel
facts: Belkahve Tunnel, a twin‑tube marvel, stretches 1,556 m and 1,653 m, each tube 12 m wide with 6 m clearance, carrying three lanes of traffic in every direction.
Construction employed the New Austrian Tunnelling Method, advancing an average of 4 m per day while 60 workers labored beneath the hill.
Opened on 8 March 2017 by Prime Minister Binali Yıldırım, the tunnel followed a groundbreaking ceremony held on 7 July 2013 with the Minister of Transport in attendance.
